Topic: OpenSSH Server explicit activation and literal restore candidate

Candidate.CapabilityServicing: Not implemented by this candidate; OpenSSH.Server~~~~0.0.1.0 must already be Installed.
Candidate.TargetGuard: Native Windows 11 or Windows Server 2025 candidate build; no support declaration.

Boundary.Service: Requires existing administrator session and no pending servicing restart; explicitly starts sshd and sets caller-selected Manual or Automatic startup.
Boundary.Firewall: Caller chooses Keep, Enabled or Disabled. Only the exact existing local OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP inbound TCP/22 rule can be changed; no rule is created.
Boundary.HostKeysAndConfiguration: No private key contents are read or copied. First-start data changes are reported and retained during restore; exact data recovery is unsupported.
Boundary.SavedState: Pre-change literal service and firewall state is stored before mutation under ProgramData/RIDE/State/OpenSshServerActivation with a protected machine ACL; restore checks target identity, servicing revision and live-state drift.
Boundary.Recovery: Restores service State/StartMode and firewall Enabled when they match saved/requested literals; refuses unrelated drift.
